title: Sweet Hash Canadian Breakfast
description: A hearty breakfast dish from Canada with sweet and nourishing ingredients. Perfect for a cozy morning.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of the sweet maple syrup over medium heat.
2. Add the hash to the pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the chopped dates to the pan and stir to combine with the hash.
4. Pour in the almond milk and stir to combine with the hash and dates.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes.
6. Serve the sweet hash hot, drizzled with the remaining maple syrup.
